content.text:
The site's custom font had stopped loading on every page. I fixed it, and the 16 functional tests pass.

**Cause:** `site/css/tokens.css` loaded the font from `../font/acme-sans.woff2`, but the folder is `site/fonts/`. The request failed, so every page fell back to the system font. That fits "the whole site looks different", since all six pages use `tokens.css`.

**Fix:** I changed the path to `../fonts/acme-sans.woff2`. The server now returns the file with a 200.

**What I couldn't check:** the repo has only one commit, so I couldn't see which change introduced the typo. I also didn't look at the pages in a browser. The tests are functional, so they wouldn't catch a visual problem. I found no other broken asset references, but if something still looks off, tell me which page and what's different.

I haven't committed anything.

STATUS: DONE
